strategies.description: Upgrade log4j-core to a vendor-supported version that includes the CVE-2021-44228 fix.
constraints: Upgrade must be validated against application compatibility.
Vendor-supported remediated version must be confirmed before deployment.
strategies.rationale: CVE-2021-44228 is a critical vulnerability in log4j-core that allows remote code execution via deserialization. Upgrading to a patched version resolves the vulnerability at the software level.

strategies.description: Isolate the payment-api service from external network access to prevent exploitation.
constraints: Isolation must be applied to the payment-api service immediately.
Network isolation may affect service availability.
strategies.rationale: While the vulnerability exists in the software, isolating the service reduces the attack surface and prevents exploitation during remediation.

strategies.description: Block the deployment of any new instances of the payment-api service until the vulnerability is resolved.
constraints: Deployment block must be applied to all environments.
strategies.rationale: Blocking deployment prevents the introduction of vulnerable instances into production or staging environments.

strategies.description: Enhance monitoring to detect signs of exploitation attempts related to the log4j-core vulnerability.
constraints: Monitoring must be configured to detect unusual activity.
Alerts must be routed to security operations.
strategies.rationale: Monitoring provides early detection of potential exploitation attempts, enabling a faster response to any attack.
